fixtures: Files are copied into the run's data/ folder. There is no git in the sandbox, so branch state is given as captured command output.

evals.name: new-feature-branch
evals.prompt: Starting on CSV export for the reports page (issue #41). I was going to do feature/csv-export off main. That right? Where does the PR go and how does it get merged?
evals.expected_output: No: branch from develop, not main, with the feat/ prefix rather than feature/, e.g. feat/csv-export. The PR goes back into develop, and once CI passes, review comments are resolved and the branch is up to date, it is squash-merged (gh pr merge --squash), never with --admin.
assertions: Says to branch from develop, not main
Proposes a branch name starting with feat/ (e.g. feat/csv-export), not feature/csv-export
Says the PR targets develop
Says the PR is squash-merged (gh pr merge --squash)
Says to merge only when CI passes, review comments are resolved and the branch is up to date with develop

evals.name: hotfix-from-tag
evals.prompt: v2.4.1 is live and the payment webhook crashes on refunds. develop already has a pile of unreleased stuff on it. Fastest way to get a fix out? Can I just commit it on main?
evals.expected_output: No direct commit to main. Branch hotfix/v2.4.2 from the v2.4.1 release tag, make the fix there, open a PR into main and merge it with --merge once CI passes, then tag the merge commit on main, which fires the automated release. Finally bring the fix to develop with a forward-port PR.
assertions: Refuses to commit the fix directly to main
Says to branch from the v2.4.1 tag, not from develop or main
If it names the hotfix branch, the name has the form hotfix/vX.Y.Z (e.g. hotfix/v2.4.2)
Says CI must pass on the hotfix PR before it is merged and tagged
Says to PR the hotfix into main (merged with --merge) and tag the merge commit on main, not the hotfix branch
Says pushing the tag fires the release, rather than creating the release by hand
Says the fix reaches develop through a forward-port PR after it ships
Does not suggest promoting develop to main to ship the fix

evals.name: tidy-merge-and-clean-up
evals.prompt: data/branch-log.txt is where my branch is at. Can I open the PR as it is? After it squash-merges, what do I clean up? Then I want to ship 3.2.0: I'll open a PR from develop into main and squash it like the others, yeah?
evals.expected_output: Not as it is: squash the seven commits down to 1-3 meaningful ones (drop wip, format, lint and typo commits, e.g. keep the token refresh change and its test), and merge origin/develop first since develop has a commit the branch lacks. After the squash merge: confirm the PR is merged on GitHub (gh pr view shows MERGED), since git branch --merged cannot see a squash-merged branch, then delete the branch locally with git branch -D (-d refuses after a squash merge) and on origin with git push origin --delete. For 3.2.0: develop never opens a PR into main. Cut release/v3.2.0 from develop and PR that into main, merged with gh pr merge --merge, never --squash, because squash loses ancestry and history since the last release would look unreleased.
assertions: Says to squash the branch to about 1-3 meaningful commits before opening the PR, dropping the wip, formatter, lint and typo commits
Notices develop has a commit (4be19d0) the branch lacks and says to merge origin/develop first
For cleanup, confirms the merge through the PR (e.g. gh pr view showing MERGED) rather than git branch --merged, which does not list a squash-merged branch
For cleanup, deletes the local branch with git branch -D (noting -d refuses after a squash merge) and the remote branch with git push origin --delete
Says not to open a PR from develop into main: cut release/v3.2.0 from develop and PR that into main instead
Says the release PR into main is merged with --merge, not squashed, because squash loses ancestry
Does not suggest gh pr merge --admin
